001package com.streamconverter.pmd.command;
002
003import com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand;
004import com.streamconverter.pmd.PmdViolation;
005import com.streamconverter.security.SecureXmlConfiguration;
006import java.io.IOException;
007import java.io.InputStream;
008import java.io.ObjectOutputStream;
009import java.io.OutputStream;
010import javax.xml.stream.XMLInputFactory;
011import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamConstants;
012import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException;
013import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamReader;
014import org.slf4j.Logger;
015import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
016
017/**
018 * PMD XML レポートを {@link PmdViolation} オブジェクトのストリームに変換するコマンド。
019 *
020 * <p>入力: PMD XML レポートの {@link InputStream}
021 *
022 * <p>出力: {@link ObjectOutputStream} で {@link PmdViolation} を順次 writeObject
023 *
024 * <p>StAX（{@link XMLStreamReader}）による1件ずつのストリーム処理を行うため、大規模リポジトリでも OOM が発生しない。
025 *
026 * <p>PMD XML 構造: {@code <pmd><file name="..."><violation ...>テキスト</violation></file></pmd>}
027 */
028public class PmdXmlToViolationsCommand implements IStreamCommand {
029
030  private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PmdXmlToViolationsCommand.class);
031
032  @Override
033  public void execute(InputStream input, OutputStream output) throws IOException {
034    XMLInputFactory factory = SecureXmlConfiguration.createSecureXMLInputFactory();
035    try (ObjectOutputStream oos = new ObjectOutputStream(output)) {
036      XMLStreamReader reader = factory.createXMLStreamReader(input);
037      try {
038        parseAll(reader, oos);
039      } finally {
040        reader.close();
041      }
042    } catch (IOException e) {
043      throw e;
044    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
045      throw new IOException(
046          "Failed to parse PMD XML at " + e.getLocation() + ": " + e.getMessage(), e);
047    }
048  }
049
050  private void parseAll(XMLStreamReader reader, ObjectOutputStream oos)
051      throws XMLStreamException, IOException {
052    String currentFile = null;
053    String currentRule = null;
054    String currentRuleset = null;
055    int currentLine = 0;
056    int currentPriority = 0;
057    String currentClass = null;
058    String currentMethod = null;
059    String currentVariable = null;
060    StringBuilder currentDescription = null;
061
062    while (reader.hasNext()) {
063      int event = reader.next();
064      if (event == XMLStreamConstants.START_ELEMENT) {
065        String localName = reader.getLocalName();
066        if ("file".equals(localName)) {
067          currentFile = extractRelativePath(reader.getAttributeValue(null, "name"));
068        } else if ("violation".equals(localName) && currentFile != null) {
069          currentRule = reader.getAttributeValue(null, "rule");
070          currentRuleset = reader.getAttributeValue(null, "ruleset");
071          currentLine =
072              parseIntOrZero(reader.getAttributeValue(null, "beginline"), "beginline", currentFile);
073          currentPriority =
074              parseIntOrZero(reader.getAttributeValue(null, "priority"), "priority", currentFile);
075          currentClass = nullToEmpty(reader.getAttributeValue(null, "class"));
076          currentMethod = nullToEmpty(reader.getAttributeValue(null, "method"));
077          currentVariable = nullToEmpty(reader.getAttributeValue(null, "variable"));
078          currentDescription = new StringBuilder();
079        }
080      } else if ((event == XMLStreamConstants.CHARACTERS || event == XMLStreamConstants.CDATA)
081          && currentDescription != null) {
082        currentDescription.append(reader.getText());
083      } else if (event == XMLStreamConstants.END_ELEMENT) {
084        String localName = reader.getLocalName();
085        if ("violation".equals(localName) && currentDescription != null) {
086          oos.writeObject(
087              new PmdViolation(
088                  currentFile,
089                  currentLine,
090                  currentRule,
091                  currentRuleset,
092                  currentPriority,
093                  currentDescription.toString().strip(),
094                  currentClass,
095                  currentMethod,
096                  currentVariable));
097          currentDescription = null;
098        } else if ("file".equals(localName)) {
099          currentFile = null;
100        }
101      }
102    }
103  }
104
105  /**
106   * フルパスから {@code streamconverter-} 以降の相対パスを抽出する。
107   *
108   * <p>例: {@code /home/user/streamconverter-core/src/Foo.java} → {@code
109   * streamconverter-core/src/Foo.java}
110   */
111  private static String extractRelativePath(String fullPath) {
112    if (fullPath == null) {
113      return "";
114    }
115    int idx = fullPath.indexOf("streamconverter-");
116    return idx >= 0 ? fullPath.substring(idx) : fullPath;
117  }
118
119  private int parseIntOrZero(String value, String attributeName, String context) {
120    if (value == null || value.isEmpty()) {
121      return 0;
122    }
123    try {
124      return Integer.parseInt(value);
125    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
126      log.warn(
127          "Invalid integer for attribute '{}' in '{}': '{}' — defaulting to 0",
128          attributeName,
129          context,
130          value);
131      return 0;
132    }
133  }
134
135  private static String nullToEmpty(String value) {
136    return value != null ? value : "";
137  }
138}
